summary: Busy installs no longer fall behind in reporting their runs to Invardia.

fixes.title: Run reports catch up quickly
fixes.text: An install with many runs could fall days behind in reporting them to Invardia. It now sends more at a time and clears a backlog within a few reports.

fixes.title: Failed runs are reported first
fixes.text: Failed runs and update runs now reach Invardia first, while each job's runs still arrive in order so nothing is skipped.
